snippet.title: Instant Impact - Release Trailer - Playdate
snippet.description:
Welcome to Instant Impact.

A fast-paced microgame for the Playdate.
Chain quick actions, react fast, and beat your high score in 30 / 60 or until you failed.

🕹 Brutalist black & white aesthetic
⚡️ Reflex-based gameplay
⏱ Built for short, intense play sessions

➡️ Play now on itch.io: https://mamonaku.itch.io/instant-impact

—

Made by Mamonaku Studio.
Follow my journey as a solo developer mixing code, design, and music.

▶️ More games & devlogs: https://x.com/MamonakuStudio

#Playdate #IndieGame #Microgame #InstantImpact #MaMoNaKu #SoloDev
